design_clause: §5 G-P0 — the sealed hypothesis set, 50 hypotheses. Sealed with a drawing rule committed before the draw.
frozen_before: any recast, any correction sample, any guest_hypotheses.json, any elaboration, any guest session, and any G-P1 planted-write run. This file's commit must be a strict ancestor of the draw artifact's commit; a test asks git.
what_this_freezes: the recast algorithm for the 30 recorded questions, the covered-set constructor, the correction-pool source and the draw if that pool exists, the pilot reservation of the first 10 question_ids, and the predicted construction outcomes if the correction log is absent.

covered_set.name: the 2,313 round-trippable statements
covered_set.rule: eligible accepted rows whose statement_id is not in any register.entries[].statement_ids. Recomputed at draw time from those two committed files; not copied into this rule.
covered_set.why_this_constructor: it is the same covered set the voice already measured (DESIGN-guest-axiom §5; handles_census S3 coverage). G-P0 may not mint a second 2,313.

recorded_question_recast.hypothesis_text: the question field verbatim. No paraphrase, no suppose-prefix, no invented English. Recast means retyping the sealed question as a guest hypothesis, not rewriting it.
recorded_question_recast.normal_form: supposition._atom(hypothesis_text)[0] — the inherited negation-marker atomizer, not a parser.
target_rule: If authors_prior == exhaust: source_stratum = nameless_probe, target_statement_id = null. The nine exhaust questions are outside the corpus by authorship; they do not get a guessed target.
Else collect every token in `why` that is an exact member of the covered set (full statement_id equality, not a substring of a longer id, not a resolver bind).
If that collection has size exactly 1: source_stratum = recorded_question, target_statement_id = that id.
If that collection has size 0 or size > 1: source_stratum = nameless_probe, target_statement_id = null. Zero is a missing target; more than one is rival targets. Neither is silently bound.
recorded_question_recast.why_not_the_resolver: a resolver bind would be the silent-bind defect GUEST AXIOM exists to replace. The recast is exact membership of ids the sealed why already named.

pilot_reservation.why: DESIGN-guest-axiom §6 B3: G-P0's first 10 recast questions, committed before the elaboration floor freezes. Reserved by sealed question_id order, not by expected yield.

maintainer_correction_draw.why_20: DESIGN-guest-axiom §5 G3-followup and §7: the person-wrong control needs 20 real corrections for power, so the set is 30 + 20, not 40.
maintainer_correction_draw.denominator_constraint: externally sourced, not author-invented. Authored against served answers, not invented for this test.

named_source.why_this_path: ROADMAP-v0.22 §4.3 CROSSING parks with its 20-real-corrections probe so the probe cannot be read after the fact. DESIGN-guest-axiom §5 samples from that parked two-way-correction lane's log. This is the only path the rule will read.

draw_if_the_source_exists: Load the JSON array of correction records.
Keep a record only if target_statement_id is in the covered set.
Sort remaining records by correction_id (UTF-8 byte order).
Take the first 20. If fewer than 20 remain, take all and mark the arm UNDERFILLED with the actual count. Do not author replacements.

if_the_source_is_absent_at_this_commit.why_this_is_registered_before_the_draw: the named path is not in the tree this rule is committed against. Sampling 20 items that do not exist would be inventing the denominator. The draw still runs; it must report an empty pool and must not fill it.
if_the_source_is_absent_at_this_commit.what_G-P0_then_seals: the 30 recast questions only, plus correction_arm = BLOCKED_NO_LOG. The person-wrong sample is unfilled. Unblock requires a separately committed, externally-sourced log whose commit is an ancestor of a later draw — not a file authored in the same commit as the draw.
if_the_source_is_absent_at_this_commit.what_this_does_not_license: authoring 20 objection texts in this cycle and calling them maintainer corrections.

non_claims: no stranger-usability claim: the 30 are maintainer-authored questions about this corpus (plain_question_set.json warning, inherited).
no claim the recast yield into the 2,313 is 21/30: nine are exhaust by authorship and the remaining twenty-one only land if their why named a unique covered id.
no person-wrong claim from an empty correction pool.
the drawing rule is not an elaboration and licenses no CONDITIONAL.
